owner_instruction: claude is reviewing, arm a monitor for its next push. when it pushes, counter review first. then: 1. build the project until ready for qc backtesting 2. testing the following 6 universes: S&P 500 / U.S. large-cap stocks; Healthcare; Energy; NASDAQ; Semiconductors; Rare Earth and Strategic Metals.
purpose: six exploratory constituent-stock order-based QC tests; not ETF strategy or canonical stock-primary acceptance

universes.label: S&P 500 / U.S. large-cap
universes.definition: historical QC-covered US-equity SPY constituents; S&P 500 ETF proxy, not all US large-caps or an official unbiased index replication

universes.label: Healthcare
universes.definition: historical QC-covered US-equity XLV constituents; S&P 500 healthcare sleeve, not all healthcare stocks

universes.label: Energy
universes.definition: historical QC-covered US-equity XLE constituents; S&P 500 energy sleeve, not all energy or clean-energy equities

universes.label: NASDAQ
universes.definition: historical QC-covered US-equity QQQ constituents; Nasdaq-100 proxy, NOT all Nasdaq-listed stocks

universes.label: Semiconductors
universes.definition: historical QC-covered US-equity SOXX constituents; semiconductor manufacturers and equipment sleeve as selected by this ETF, not the whole technology sector

universes.label: Rare Earth and Strategic Metals
universes.definition: historical QC-covered US-equity REMX thematic constituents intersecting admitted domestic common-stock source identities; excludes unavailable foreign holdings, not complete global rare-earth/strategic-metals exposure, and not broad mining/gold/uranium

membership.source: QuantConnect US ETF Constituents with Security Master, in cloud only
membership.rule: latest received complete callback snapshot whose effective timestamp is at least seven calendar days before prior-session cutoff and whose receipt is no later than cutoff
membership.missing_snapshot: refuse that decision, count it; not an empty valid universe
membership.missing_constituents: retain distinct missing_identity, missing_signal, refused and ineligible coverage states; never classify as a zero signal
membership.identity_limit: current-vintage Sharadar identity/current ticker intersection remains non-PIT and survivorship-biased even with historical QC membership
membership.coverage_claim: record callback count and weight, admitted-signal count and weight, missing/refused count and weight; never renormalize the US slice into a complete global book
membership.overlap: SPY overlaps XLV/XLE/QQQ/SOXX and QQQ overlaps SOXX; six cases are correlated, not independent confirmatory tests

signal.source_access: fresh bounded read of exactly the section-64 structure.json, not D0 or old outcome files; no source refresh
signal.caveat: later updates censor earlier events; as-captured payload and current identity are not historical vintages; horizon/share-basis comparability remains unverified
signal.formula: raw_new/prior-1 clipped [-1,1]; frozen raw_candidate.py aggregation, 20-session half-life, maximum age 80; USD eligible domestic common stocks
signal.timing: second eligible exchange open after issue date, already eligible by prior-session 18:00 America/New_York cutoff
signal.payload: all source identities and all fourteen weekly score frames with explicit missing states, not the previous global 43 winners
signal.ranking: within each lagged constituent universe positive top ten, native security-id tie-break, 0.10 each, residual cash; no rank substitution after price or liquidity refusal

economics.rebalance: weekly first exchange session; only the frozen fourteen decision sessions; no daily retry of unfilled target deltas
economics.execution: MOO submission at 09:20 America/New_York, cancel still-open day orders at 09:35; no retry before next frozen weekly frame
economics.sizing: whole-share floor of 10% prior-close portfolio NAV / prior-session close, complete zero exits for other held names
economics.volume_limit: cap submitted absolute quantity at floor(0.01 * prior completed-session raw share volume), report requested-minus-submitted as capacity shortfall, not a QC partial fill
economics.buy_cash: only cash available before orders; do not assume MOO sell proceeds; reserve 3% opening-gap buffer plus fee and slippage in estimated affordability; actual gap rejection remains possible
economics.corporate_actions: QC RAW prices and native Security Master split/dividend/delisting handling; immediate settlement model; dividend cash may be spent on later decisions
economics.split_rule: adjust cached prior close and share volume to current split basis before sizing; invalidate ambiguous/missing basis
economics.comparison_to_local: not identical economics: native cash dividends rather than indefinite receivables; participation capped before submission rather than partial local fills; no immediate recycling of anticipated sale proceeds; prior-close name sizing rather than open-NAV cap; real QC MOO pricing and gap rejects
economics.benchmark_interpretation: corresponding ETF benchmark for context, not tradable strategy holdings or full total-return replication claim

evaluation.completion: Completed plus usable source/membership data, meaningful genuine orders/fills and interpretable coverage/accounting; zero-trade Completed remains diagnostic
evaluation.new_looks: each cloud backtest launch counts prospectively, failed attempts retained; no refund or economic tuning after observed results

operations.attempt_definition: reserve before compile; compile/runtime/unsuccessful terminal run consumes the attempt; no reset across fixes or sessions
operations.source_upload: plaintext canonical JSON <=16MiB in fresh content-addressed private Object Store key tpr-qc6/TPR-QC6-20261008-v1/<sha256>.json; readable main.py and configuration only; no encoded or packed code
allowed_actions: one plaintext own-input Object Store upload
operations.after_third_unsuccessful_attempt: no more Codex fixes/relaunch for that candidate; authenticated controllable Mia recovery only, otherwise report exact owner action
